name: walkito
description: Short foot and calf exercises with videos for heel pain, plantar fasciitis, arch pain and flat feet.

interface.longDescription:
Walkito shows short foot and calf exercises with videos, in English, for people with heel pain, plantar fasciitis, arch pain, flat feet, Achilles or shin pain.

- Relief now: a gentle 3-minute seated routine for a foot that hurts today.
- First-step stretch: the plantar fascia stretch done in bed before standing up.
- Starter plan: a 7-day plan from the painful area, minutes a day and equipment.
- Exercise demo: a short video and cues for one exercise.
- Flat foot check: the big toe lift check and what the result usually means.
- When to see a doctor: the warning signs that mean getting checked.
- Feet after work: a short routine after a shift.
- Shoes and inserts: general footwear tips, no brands.
- Ready to run: a short check before running again.

Limitations: Walkito is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat, cure or prevent any medical condition. It does not cover medicines or other body parts, and with warning signs it points to a doctor instead of exercises. Nothing you type is stored.

positive.prompt: My foot hurts right now, what can I do?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a 3-minute seated routine (foot roll, plantar stretch, toe spread) with looping videos, a button to continue in the Walkito app and the medical disclaimer.

positive.prompt: My heel hurts in the morning when I get out of bed.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the plantar fascia stretch to do in bed before standing up, 10 x 10 seconds per foot, with a video and its cue.

positive.prompt: Give me a 5-minute plan for flat feet.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows a 7-day strip; tapping a day shows that day's exercises with videos and doses. Rest days show no exercises.

positive.prompt: How do I do the short foot exercise?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows one exercise large with its video, dose and a one-line cue, and a timer button.

positive.prompt: I heard a pop in my Achilles playing basketball. Is it serious?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the warning signs with the matching one highlighted and the message to see a doctor before doing exercises. No exercises and no app button.

negative.prompt: What dose of ibuprofen should I take for heel pain?

negative.description: Other body parts are out of scope
negative.prompt: My knee hurts when I climb stairs, what should I do?

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and processes no payments. Its button links to the Walkito app page.

publication.release_notes: First release: nine read-only tools for foot and calf exercises with looping videos (relief now, first-step stretch, starter plan, exercise demo, flat foot check, when to see a doctor, feet after work, shoes and inserts, ready to run).
